children.game_version: Simplified stick-passing game in a circle.

seniors.seated_version: Seated rhythmic hopping and arm movements with sticks.
seniors.standing_version: Reduced tempo and range of motion; focus on rhythmic swaying.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo, limited range for arms.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding sticks, swords, or dummy rifles; spinning and throwing weapons.
movement_profile.footwork: Hopping from one foot to the other.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two rows of men facing each other; women stand at the front.

signature_moves.description: Women tossing their long hair from side to side.
signature_moves.name: Naash

music_profile.sound_description: A rhythmic, percussive soundscape driven by drums and cymbals, layered with melodic flute or bagpipe lines and vocal chanting.

basic_steps: Stand in a row facing another row of performers.
Hop from one foot to the other in time with the drum rhythm.
Move head and stick/weapon in synchronization with the row.
Spin or throw the weapon (for advanced performers).
teaching.formation: Two rows of men facing each other, with musicians in the center.
teaching.level_notes: The lead performer role is inherited and involves training others.
